practice.title: Detect-and-explain: OSI Model
steps: Reproduce a realistic OSI Model scenario in the lab and record what normal looks like.
Identify the one signal that reveals the problem and explain why it matters.
Propose the countermeasure and state its cost or limitation.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on OSI Model for Network Administration. Finish it by checking that traffic flows as intended and a deliberately introduced fault is diagnosed.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply OSI Model
projects.description: Apply OSI Model for Network Administration and produce a configured topology with addressing and routing documented. Then check that traffic flows as intended and a deliberately introduced fault is diagnosed.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of OSI Model by producing a configured topology with addressing and routing documented and verifying that traffic flows as intended and a deliberately introduced fault is diagnosed.
requirements: A configured topology with addressing and routing documented that genuinely applies OSI Model for Network Administration.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: traffic flows as intended and a deliberately introduced fault is diagnosed.
outcomes: Working topology diagram plus device configurations.
A short written explanation of OSI Model you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
